chunks: Ahmad ibn Ali al-Razi, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq al-Muqri, from al-Miqani, from Bakkar, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad, from Ja'far ibn Sa'id al-Asadi, from (his father), from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him).
He said: In the year or the time of the Opening (Reappearance), the Euphrates will split open until it enters the lanes of Kufa.

key_terms.الْفَتْحِ: The Opening (al-Fath), referring to the reappearance of Imam Mahdi
key_terms.الْكُوفَةِ: Kufa, a major city in Iraq
key_terms.يَنْشَقُّ: It will split or open up

ai.seo_question: What is the sign of the Euphrates splitting mentioned in Shia hadith regarding the reappearance of Imam Mahdi?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a.s.) highlights the drying of the Euphrates as a major cosmic sign preceding the reappearance of Imam Mahdi (a.s.), a phenomenon widely discussed in Shia eschatology as a precursor to the emergence of the Mahdi's treasure. The specific mention of Kufa underscores its enduring spiritual and political significance in Shia tradition, linking this natural miracle directly to the heart of the Imamate's historical presence.
